children: Financials stocks remain a focal point for investors as mortgage services, digital payments, and alternative asset management continue to drive growth across the sector.

While many financial companies trade at premium valuations, investors seeking a combination of growth and value may find opportunities among names that continue to expand revenue while maintaining attractive fundamentals.

Below is a list of financials stocks with a Seeking Alpha Valuation Grade of A or higher that are ranked according to year-over-year revenue growth. The screen highlights companies operating across mortgage finance, technology finance, payment processing, health insurance, and asset management, all of which combine strong revenue growth with favorable valuation metrics.
The list is led by Rocket Companies, Inc.
, which posted year-over-year revenue growth of 98.82%. Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp.
and Sezzle Inc.
follow with growth rates of 55.63% and 43.06%, respectively.
Oscar Health, Inc.
and TPG Inc.
round out the top five with revenue growth of 42.82% and 31.28%. Notably, Blue Owl Technology Finance carries the highest A+ Valuation Grade on the list.

Seeking Alpha's Valuation Grade measures how expensive a stock is relative to its fundamentals, with A+ representing the most attractive valuations and F representing the least attractive. The companies below were screened for attractive valuations and are ranked solely according to their year-over-year revenue growth rates.
